source: QZ issue #3374 official Life Fitness app HCI capture
model: Life Fitness 95T with Discover SE console
evidenceTier: upstream hardware-observed single-capture evidence; not FitBridge tier H

wireFacts.sequenceByte: unsigned byte 6; increments within each captured session, but protocol semantics are not assigned
wireFacts.byte7: session-stable byte observed as 0x04 in session 1 and 0x2A in session 2; semantics are not assigned
wireFacts.checksum: sum of all 40 bytes modulo 256 equals 0xF1; inferred and satisfied by every captured measurement

privacy: Contains only recurring 40-byte measurements, anonymous sequence, session number and session-relative timing. Addresses, exact device name, absolute timestamps, profile/workout writes and unrelated GATT traffic are omitted.
